base_trajectory_metrics: Reuse pinned source implementation, same phase/lag/distance/coverage semantics; separate new receipt
derivative: backward adjacent finite .01s pairs; PRIMARY includes all interventions/reset boundaries

distance.coordinate: observed pose_x_m, updated-heading Euler plant integration
distance.interpolation: piecewise linear on strictly increasing observed x; no extrapolation
distance.secondary: full observed distance descriptive only; no meter envelope classification

events.mask: all finite samples; boundary jump separately recorded

lag.ambiguity: exact tied maxima -> ambiguous descriptive value; flat/insufficient=null
lag.tie_break: max correlation then minimum absolute lag then signed lag

phases: Use frozen exogenous scenario labels ENTRY/APEX/EXIT/REVERSAL/STRAIGHT; never infer from outputs
quantiles: numpy linear p50/p90/p95/max; RMS separately; no weighted score
saturation_transitions: adjacent boolean change; never infer native prelimit intent
secondary_mask: active not pressed contiguous pairs, never join gaps/resets; disclose separately
settling: exact final constant-input run; first sample after which output==constant input for remainder; no tolerance threshold
sign_reversal: remove exact zeros within contiguous series, count nonzero sign changes

spectrum.band_basis: existing native jerk cutoff and 100Hz Nyquist
spectrum.window: demeaned Hann on full contiguous command stream

steady_bias: mean(output-input) on final constant-input run, disclose length and absent run
zero_crossing: strict adjacent product<0; exact zero touch is not direct crossing
